date_basis: 2026-09-24 session date; no wall-clock timestamp asserted
purpose: Build one 8-bit rotor that closes the Enigma rotor holes, and measure it. Do not promote it into a cipher.
enigma_holes_this_rotor_closes: A rotor is a permutation of 26 letters. This rotor is a permutation of 256 symbols.
The reflector makes the whole machine an involution. This rotor must not be an involution.
A historical rotor is one wheel plus a ring offset. An XOR-offset of a single wiring is not a second rotor.
A notch odometer is not the selection rule. The formula has no turnover position.

feistel.round_function: inversion in GF(16), with 0 mapping to 0
feistel.split: high nibble is L, low nibble is R; each round is L,R = R, L XOR f(R)

search.exclude: any map whose DDT histogram equals the multiplicative inverse, including the AES S-box
search.selection: among the remainder, minimum differential-uniformity peak, then minimum absolute Walsh peak, then maximum algebraic degree

acceptance: not a translation x |-> x XOR c
DDT histogram differs from the inverse
integral_prediction: Any bijection in this SPN shares the AES twin's integral reach. Equal surviving rounds are the expected result, not a win over AES.
